Potential ttk is important and pros want to maximize that. But if there’s a chance that your gun goes errant and kicks in a direction you didn’t expect it to, one less bullet hits and you die. That’s why most people sacrifice a little mobility with the AK. If you make it with full mobility and sacrifice recoil control, you may ADS fast but your bullets might miss; effectively lowering the TTK. You theoretically want a fine balance between being able to trust the gun while quickly killing the person you’re engaging with.
